'''Bacon soup''' is a [[soup]] made with [[bacon]]. Generally a number of [[vegetable]]s are added<ref>{{cite book | last1=Kaminsky | first1=P. | last2=Rama | first2=M. | title=Bacon Nation: 125 Irresistible Recipes | publisher=Workman Publishing | year=2013 | isbn=978-0-7611-6582-8 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Z5_uPmxbI7sC&pg=PA58 | language=es | access-date=February 12, 2015 | pages=58–59}}</ref> and often a thickening agent such as [[pearl barley]], [[lentils]]<ref>{{cite book | last1=Hanson | first1=B.J. | last2=Hanson | first2=J. | title=The Everything Soup Cookbook | publisher=F+W Media | year=2002 | isbn=978-1-60550-571-8 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=qPvYPkqaig0C&pg=PA270 | access-date=February 12, 2015 | page=270}}</ref> or [[Cornstarch|corn flour]]. It can be added to Italian [[minestrone]] soup to enhance the flavor.<ref>{{cite book |title=Tablet to Table Vol 1 Issue 3 |date=11 November 2012 |publisher=Tercio Publishing |isbn=9781925033045 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=qeJRpZkLC4sC}}</ref>

Many variations exist, which may incorporate primary ingredients such as [[cabbage]],<ref>{{cite book | last=Johnson | first=F.K. | title=Delicious Soup Recipes | publisher=Fraser Keith Johnson | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=kmSzTtYInjcC&pg=PA22 | language=es | access-date=January 24, 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite book | last=Norris | first=A. | title=Yummy Soup Cookbook: A Collection of Tasty and Simple Homemade Soup Recipes | publisher=MaxHouse | year=2014 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=T02uAwAAQBAJ&pg=PT62 | access-date=January 24, 2015}}</ref> beans,<ref>{{cite book | last=Larsen | first=L.J. | title=Knack Soup Classics: Chowders, Gumbos, Bisques, Broths, Stocks, and Other Delicious Soups | publisher=Globe Pequot Press | year=2009 | isbn=978-0-7627-6154-8 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=SOQnp6Y77ikC&pg=PA74 | access-date=2015-02-12 | pages=74–75}}</ref> potato,<ref>{{cite book | last=Patch | first=Gooseberry | title=Our Favorite Soup & Bread Recipes Cookbook: 2 Cookbooks in One...Soup in One Half, Bread in the Other | publisher=Gooseberry Patch | series=Our Favorite Recipes Collection | year=2012 | isbn=978-1-62093-061-8 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=kRlHAAAAQBAJ&pg=PT40 | access-date=February 12, 2015 | page=40}}</ref> lentils, spinach, peas, cauliflower, broccoli, leeks, pumpkin<ref>{{cite book | last=Media | first=A. | title=Bacon!: From Bacon Tacos to Bacon Mac N' Cheese, 50 Sizzling Recipes! | publisher=F+W Media | year=2013 | isbn=978-1-4405-6535-9 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=pbE7AAAAQBAJ&pg=PA24 | access-date=February 12, 2015 | page=24}}</ref> and rice.<ref>{{cite book | last=Williams | first=E.J. | title=Yenni in the Rhythm of Everyday | publisher=Q-Press Publishing | year=2011 | isbn=978-0-9871695-4-9 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=oPhB0dDew4gC&pg=PA27 | access-date=February 12, 2015 | page=27}}</ref>

Bacon is a common addition to many soups including creamy soups, especially those with a mild flavor that will not overpower the bacon.<ref>{{cite book |title= Bacon!: From Bacon Tacos to Bacon Mac N' Cheese, 50 Sizzling Recipes! | date=2013 |publisher=Adams Media | isbn=978-1-4405-6535-9 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=T6rrDQAAQBAJ&dq=bacon+soup&pg=PT50}}</ref>
